boundaries.label: Extension surfaces — clients of the worker
The service worker bundle — the only holder of the session and the SDK
The contract — one protocol, validated by both ends

cards.title: The layer contract
items: domain owns entities, rules and ports; application owns use cases, orchestration and the policy resolver; adapters own storage, messaging, the SDK, alarms, identity and offscreen
core owns ports and pure types and imports nothing else — it is the one thing every layer may depend on
domain and application never import chrome.*, the DOM, React or the SDK: a use case that cannot run without a browser was never a use case

cards.title: Ports belong to the consumer
items: SessionStore, KeyValueStore<T>, PolicySource, Clock, JobQueue and SdkClient are declared by application; RpcTransport by ui and content; OffscreenParser by application
the adapter implements the port: chrome.storage.session for SessionStore, chrome.storage.local for KeyValueStore, storage/IndexedDB plus alarms for JobQueue, the generated SDK for SdkClient
the composition root wires the real adapters; tests wire fakes and the use case does not change

cards.title: The walls are machine-checked
items: no-restricted-globals and no-restricted-imports deny chrome in src/domain and src/application
src/ui may not import @/sdk; src/content may not import @/sdk, @/session or @/auth; src/sdk may not import chrome, react or @/session
no-eval, no-new-func and no-implied-eval keep remote code out; ban-ts-comment and the eslint-comments rules keep the silences narrow and explained

cards.title: One feature = one slice
items: src/features/<feature>/ holds that feature's domain, application, adapters, ui and content code, and the feature name repeats in the route, the SDK module, the permission prefix and the message types
a feature never imports another feature's internals: shared behavior moves to core or a shared adapter
the fix for a broken wall is to re-cut the layout, never to add a path to the exception list — a config exception is a contract change
